candidates.statement: In the following we shall identify a Young diagram $\lambda$ with the set of its boxes which we regard as a subset of $\mathbb{N}^2$ given by a graphical representation of $\lambda$ according to the French notation; namely, for a partition $\lambda=(\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_k)$ it is the set $$\label{eq:identifyNatural} \lambda = \bigcup_{1\leq i\leq k} \{1,2,\dots,\lambda_i\} \times \{i\}= \{(p,q)\in\mathbb{N}^2: 1\leq p \leq \lambda_q\}.$$

For given permutations $\sigma_1,\sigma_2\in S_l$ we shall consider colorings $h$ of the cycles of $\sigma_1$ (where each cycle is colored by the number of some column of $\lambda$) and of the cycles of $\sigma_2$ (where each cycle is colored by the number of some row of $\lambda$).
